title: Opening, birth in New Orleans, and first awareness of jazz
summary: Dufour gives his birth date and says he has lived in New Orleans all his life; recording date stated. He places first awareness of the new music in his college days.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace
